mapper.select: SELECT s.grade, s.is_demo AS demo FROM student s JOIN guardianship g ON g.student_id=s.id WHERE s.id=#{studentId} AND g.parent_user_id=#{userId} AND g.status='LINKED' AND s.status='ACTIVE'
SELECT parent_sharing_enabled FROM student WHERE id=#{studentId} AND status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET parent_sharing_enabled=#{enabled}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{studentId} AND status='ACTIVE'
